# Vendored map dependencies

Fetched from the npm registry on 2026-09-25. Each tarball was checked against its
published SHA-512 integrity before the selected distribution files were copied.
The map loads these local files only when the user opens the map.

| Package | Version | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Leaflet | 1.9.4 | https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/tree/v1.9.4 | BSD-2-Clause, `leaflet/LICENSE` |
| Leaflet.markercluster | 1.5.3 | https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet.markercluster/tree/v1.5.3 | MIT, `leaflet.markercluster/LICENSE` |

Leaflet's source-map comments refer to debugging files not included in this
distribution. Map tiles are requested separately from OpenStreetMap only for the
visible viewport. No geocoder requests are made in visitors' browsers.
